about_the_game:
Monkey Testing – Ethics or Power? The Choice is Yours!

As the head security officer of a secret research facility, oversee super soldier projects and disease treatments through cutting-edge experiments. Conduct genetic, chemical, and psychological tests on monkeys to shape the future of humanity. But remember, every experiment comes at a cost.

In this massive laboratory, you must choose between ethical principles and corporate interests. Will you remain a loyal part of a powerful system, or will you expose the hidden truths lurking in the shadows?

🔬 Key Features

SCIENTIFIC EXPERIMENTS & BEHAVIORAL TESTING

Perform chemical injections, psychological trials, and behavioral experiments as part of the super soldier program. Each test alters the intelligence, strength, and aggression levels of the monkeys.

BALANCING SECURITY AND CHAOS

Prevent the experiments from spiraling out of control. Manage your guards, stop escape attempts, and suppress riots. But be careful—too much pressure may lead to an explosive outcome.

ETHICS OR LOYALTY? THE CHOICE IS YOURS

Will you follow corporate orders to complete the experiments, or will you reveal the dark secrets of the laboratory? Your choices will shape the story’s direction.

MONKEY EXPERIMENTS & EVOLUTION MECHANICS

Monkeys can become highly intelligent, aggressive, or depressed. Maintain a delicate balance—smart monkeys may plan escapes, while aggressive ones may incite riots.

CHAOS & REBELLION SCENARIOS

If things go wrong, monkeys may riot, guards may abandon their posts, and the facility could plunge into total chaos. Maintain order or watch everything collapse.

Core Gameplay Mechanics

  • Experiment Management

  • Guard Supervision

  • Chaos and Riot Control

  • Ethical Decision-Making

  • Evidence Concealment & Whistleblowing

ADD TO YOUR WISHLIST NOW!

Maintain order, protect the system, or spark a revolution.
The line between science, ethics, and control is razor-thin… Which side will you choose?

name: Monkey Testing
short_description: As the Head Warden, maintain order in the laboratory prison! Manage experiments on test subject monkeys, enforce the scientists' commands, and uphold security. Will you turn a blind eye to unethical experiments, or will you protect the test subjects and spark a rebellion? The choice is yours!
